subject: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@fintechx.com>; procurement@fintechx.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & next steps

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Call summary (warts-and-all):
- Expected monthly token volume (prod): 45M–120M tokens depending on feature rollout cadence.
- Pilot scope: 2 core features (smart reply + document summarization), ~5–10% of active users in month 1 -> ~5–10M tokens/month for pilot.
- Annual budget range you mentioned: $60k–$250k (range reflects pilot -> full roll).
- Key asks from your side: target $/1M tokens, per-feature $ impact, CAC payback assumptions, margin sensitivity to inference cost.

Attached: Redwood-pricing-estimates.xlsx (high-level tiers + sample unit-econ calc).

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I’ll run a short unit-econ model ($/feature, gross margin vs inference cost, CAC payback) based on the 3 volume buckets we discussed and share by EOD Wed (attached spreadsheet).
2) Naomi (cc) will validate the performance/latency SLOs for the two pilot features and flag any changes that would materially affect cost.
3) Procurement — if pilot looks good, Marissa will send an SOW draft and a rough PO template for your legal/procurement review.

Questions for you before we model final pricing: can you confirm the expected average request length (tokens/request) for each feature and an initial estimate of monthly active users for pilot? If you prefer, we can schedule 20 minutes tomorrow to lock the assumptions.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & next steps

Marissa — appreciated the recap. Quick answers and a few clarifying questions: 

Answers:
- Avg tokens/request: smart reply ~60 tokens, doc summarization ~400 tokens (these are rough).
- Pilot MAU target: 12k users (5% of total MAU) -> estimate ~6–8M tokens/month for pilot since usage is bursty.
- Budget: financing team said $80k–$120k for a 3-month pilot including support/engineering engagement.

Clarifying Qs:
1) Target $/1M tokens — what's achievable at 45M vs 120M tokens? We need clear unit pricing tiers and how quantization/latency SLOs affect unit cost.
2) $/feature — can you show an example: incremental revenue per user per month assumptions, and breakeven time (CAC payback) at given pricing?
3) Margin sensitivity — our finance team wants to see worst-case gross margin if tokens cost X and churn is Y.

We can do a 20-minute call tomorrow 11a ET if that helps finalize assumptions. Procurement copied for visibility — they’ll want SOW + vendor questionnaire.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product | FintechX
liam@fintechx.com | +1 (617) 555-2222
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & next steps (internal)

Internal note / proposed modeling approach before we send to FintechX:

Assumptions (configureable in attached sheet):
- Feature set: Smart reply (avg 60 tokens/request), Doc summarization (avg 400 tokens/request).
- Pilot usage: 12k MAU, activation 20% use per month for smart reply, 6% for summarization -> estimates below.

Volume buckets (monthly tokens):
- Pilot: 6–8M tokens
- Scale: 45M tokens
- High: 120M tokens

Cost assumptions (examples for model):
- Inference unit cost (post-volume discounts + batching/quantization): Pilot $4–$10 per 1M tokens, Scale $1.2–$3 per 1M, High $0.6–$1.8 per 1M. (We should show sensitivity ranges).
- Redwood commercial price target: Pilot $30–$70 per 1M, Scale $10–$25 per 1M, High $4–$12 per 1M.

Unit economics output to generate for customer:
- $/feature/month (revenue assumption e.g., $0.50–$3.50 per active user depending on feature and plan tier).
- CAC payback: using hypothetical CAC of $80–$240 per new customer and monthly ARPU contribution from features. Show 0–18 month windows.
- Gross margin sensitivity table: revenue per 1M tokens vs inference cost per 1M tokens -> margin %.

Action items for us:
1) Marissa: finalize feature-level revenue assumptions to present two go-to-market scenarios (low-touch self-serve vs enterprise).
2) Dev: confirm that latency SLOs for doc summarization at 400 tokens won't push us out of the lower cost band; if it does, mark expected uplift in cost.
3) Rafael: sanity check commercial price bands and approve model to send out.

I’ll draft the email with the model outputs once we have Marissa’s revenue assumptions; target to send to Liam Wed EOD.

Naomi
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & next steps

Liam — thanks for the quick answers. Attached is an updated pricing & unit-econ pack based on the numbers you shared (see Redwood-pricing-estimates.xlsx). High-level answers below plus next steps: 

1) Achievable $/1M tokens:
- Pilot (6–8M/month): Redwood commercial price recommendation $55 per 1M (range $45–$70) — expected inference cost $6–$9 per 1M -> gross margin ~84–89% at recommended list.
- Scale (45M/month): recommended $18 per 1M (range $12–$25) -> expected inference cost $2–$3 per 1M -> gross margin ~83–89%.
- High (120M/month): recommended $7 per 1M (range $4–$12) -> expected inference cost $0.6–$1.8 per 1M -> gross margin ~74–91% depending on cost envelope.

2) $/feature example (pilot):
- Smart reply: avg usage 12k MAU * 20% active * 60 tokens/request * avg 4 requests/user/month = ~576k tokens -> incremental revenue at $55/1M = $31.68/month; incremental cost ~$3.46 -> contribution margin ~$28.22/month.
- Doc summarization: 12k MAU * 6% active * 1 summary/user/month * 400 tokens = ~288k tokens -> revenue ~$15.84/month; cost ~$1.84 -> contribution ~$14.00/month.

3) CAC payback example:
- If CAC = $160 and combined ARPU from both features contribution = ~$46/month -> median payback ~3.5 months. We include a sensitivity table in the attachment for CAC $80–$240.

4) Margin sensitivity: see sheet — worst-case gross margin at pilot volumes with high inference cost still >60% under the conservative pricing band.

Next steps:
- I’ll schedule a 20-min sync Thu 14:00 ET to confirm the assumptions (invite sent).
- If pilot looks good, procurement — expect a draft SOW attached (SOW_Redwood_FintechX_v1.docx) and a revised PDF v2 after legal review. Please flag any must-have procurement terms.

If you want, we can also move to a small committed monthly minimum for pilot to lock in the pilot price band. Happy to discuss.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
